Cybersecurity Excellence: Email Domain & Governance Achievements
A new Power Automate workflow now provides 24/7 monitoring of critical mailbox activities, including New-InboxRule, Set-InboxRule, and Update-InboxRule detections.
The system automatically identifies mailbox forwarding changes and prepares compliance notification emails, drastically reducing the need for manual monitoring.
The solution is fully completed and ready for deployment, offering improved governance visibility and a significant reduction in manual operational overhead.
Collaborated with Microsoft to resolve temporary authentication failures and improve DNS timeout retry handling, leading to fewer delivery inconsistencies.
Standardized reverse DNS (rDNS/PTR) configuration across dedicated SendGrid IP plans to align with industry best practices.
These infrastructure improvements have strengthened sender reputation and ensured higher reliability for external email delivery platforms.
Cyber Security Strategic Achievements: Connectivity, AI & Zero Trust
Operational milestones executed to drive frictionless user adoption, robust risk mitigation, and unified secure access.
Guarantees continuous uptime and instant failover, eliminating connectivity friction to build user confidence and accelerate remote-work migration.
Redundant App Connect gateways ensure uninterrupted application access, preventing single points of failure during core operations.
Dynamic traffic load balancing minimizes latency and connection timeouts, significantly improving user experience.
Enterprise-grade high availability provides an invisible security layer that drives trust and high compliance across the organization.
Establishes transparent compliance policies and automated data loss prevention, empowering departments to leverage generative AI with total confidence.
Robust cloud-native landing zone protocols guarantee sensitive corporate IP, credentials, and data remain protected.
Built-in guardrails monitor input prompts and outputs to prevent accidental exposure of personally identifiable info (PII).
Enables business units to innovate safely under a verified, secure compliance model, encouraging organization-wide tool adoption.
Consolidates and standardizes access for three legacy entities, giving users frictionless, context-aware secure access with single sign-on (SSO).
Unifies Ejadah, Idama, and Arkan security architectures into a single secure control plane for frictionless collaboration.
Replaces complex, slow legacy VPNs with strict context-aware, posture-verified network access control (ZTNA).
A modern single-sign-on (SSO) portal removes login friction, driving extremely high adoption and adherence to security policies.
